items.title: Tim Seymour Says “This Is the Time to Buy Gold, Not Sell It”
items.summary: Gold has dropped far from its January peak, and Newmont shares are falling even faster. One Fast Money trader says the panic has little to do with gold itself, and he sees something else driving the sell-off. Is he right?

items.title: Gold miners near yearly lows as bullion slides below $3,600
items.summary: Investing.com -- Gold keeps falling, and the miners are falling with it. Gold Futures (GC) traded at $3,545.95, down 3.79%, as of Nov 20, 10:21 AM EST. That is below the $3,700–$3,800 level one strategist cited when saying miners still generate "tons of cash flow". The same pressures are at work: the 10-year yield is at 4.962%, the Dollar Index is at 103.675, and the Fed is expected to hike in December.

items.title: Will Metals Sell Off Change Newmont (NEM) Stock Narrative
items.summary: Newmont recently filed an August 2026 construction report with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission for its Blue Lake Penstock Repair Project, confirming ongoing regulatory compliance and progress on critical hydropower infrastructure. At the same time, a sharp pullback in gold and copper prices has pressured Newmont's operations, even as it reports solid third quarter production, firm cash generation and plans for higher unit costs in 2027. We will now see how this metals wide sell off...

items.title: Newmont (NEM) Slides With Metals Sell Off, Is It Trading At A 26% Discount?
items.summary: Recent pressure on Newmont (NEM) has come from outside the company, with a sharp metals sell-off tied to softer gold prices and Federal Reserve rate hike expectations that are weighing on the stock. Newmont’s share price has retreated sharply in the near term, with the stock down 4.29% over one day, 11.18% across seven days and 23.96% over ninety days. items.title: Druckenmiller Bought 3 Gold Miners. History Shows How These Moves Usually Play Out.
items.summary: Stanley Druckenmiller's Duquesne piled into Newmont, Barrick, and Agnico Eagle just before all three sank. Two past gold cycles show why miners can magnify the pain or the payoff, and one price line may decide which way this one breaks.
